name: Glace Nuts
description: Historical recipe from Canadian Farm Cook Book (1911). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

instructions.text: Boil sugar and water without stirring until thick
Add vinegar until, when dropped in cold water, it cracks
Set the saucepan on warm place, but not where it can boil
Stick nuts on ends of hat pins and, taking 2 at a time, dip into the taffy
Hold in cool place until hard enough to handle them, then drop on tin plate

source.originalInstructions:
1. Boil sugar and water without stirring until thick
2. Add vinegar until, when dropped in cold water, it cracks
3. Set the saucepan on warm place, but not where it can boil
4. Stick nuts on ends of hat pins and, taking 2 at a time, dip into the taffy
5. Hold in cool place until hard enough to handle them, then drop on tin plate
